news.headline: Analog Devices, Inc. Reports Q4 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Analog Devices, Inc. reported its fourth-quarter 2026 financial results, exceeding analyst expectations for both revenue and adjusted earnings per share.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Adjusts Price Target on Analog Devices to $575 From $550
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald has increased its price target for Analog Devices, Inc. (ADI) from $550 to $575.

news.headline: Evercore ISI Adjusts Price Target on Analog Devices
news.summary: Evercore ISI has revised its price target for Analog Devices, lowering it from $462 to $425.

news.headline: The J.M. Smucker Co. Reports Fiscal Second Quarter 2027 Financial Results
news.summary: The J.M. Smucker Co. reported fiscal second quarter 2027 revenue of $2.28 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $3.20, exceeding analyst expectations.

news.headline: Texas Instruments Reaches One Billion Chip Milestone at Melaka Facility
news.summary: Texas Instruments' TIEM2 assembly and test facility in Melaka, Malaysia, has processed one billion analog and embedded processing chips within its first year of operation.

news.headline: Rothschild & Co Redburn Adjusts Price Target on Texas Instruments
news.summary: Rothschild & Co Redburn has increased its price target for Texas Instruments to $370 from $340.

news.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Upgrades Texas Instruments to Overweight
news.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald has upgraded Texas Instruments from Neutral to Overweight, setting a new price target of $385.
